records.title: Anthurium clarinervium × forgetii pollination
records.access_level: Primary grower article inspected; factual paraphrase only
records.outcome: The author reports applying clarinervium pollen to a forgetii inflorescence, harvesting seeds and growing seedlings, while questioning whether these are true hybrids or an anomaly.
records.uncertainty: Narrative documents forgetii as seed parent and clarinervium as applied pollen; the title reverses their order. Intended pollination roles do not confirm hybrid identity. Suspected/unconfirmed hybridity; excluded from successful-cross inference. No reciprocal outcome, genetic verification or fertility established.

records.title: Anthurium (crystallinum × magnificum) × clarinervium
records.access_level: Primary grower product page inspected; factual paraphrase only
records.outcome: Steve's Leaves describes seedlings from a reported cross between a crystallinum × magnificum hybrid and clarinervium, hybridized in-house by Ryan Wilhelm.
records.uncertainty: Seed/pollen roles are not explicit; display slots and formula/title order do not establish direction. The compound parent remains a single hybrid parent, never separate pure-species cross edges. Genetic parentage and fertility are unverified. The URL spelling clarinervum is preserved verbatim; clarinervium identifies the stated species component only.
